ValidationRule.description: Projected Registered Donors is required for Fixed Site Drives having Operation Type as "Non Integrated WB"
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(sked_Type_of_Drive__c, "Fixed Site"), OR(sked_Projected_Registered_Donors__c == 0, ISBLANK(sked_Projected_Registered_Donors__c)), sked_Operation_Type__c == "Non Integrated WB")
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A non-zero value is required for Projected Registered Donors as this drive's operation type is "Non Integrated WB"
